name: Cameras & IoT (room sweep)
source: IEEE MA-L registry (Netify/IPVM cross-checked) + field-observed default SSIDs. OUIs flag the vendor, not a confirmed camera; SSID patterns are indicative of cheap Wi-Fi spy-cams and may need tuning. Verify against the live IEEE registry.
